admission.workflow: Capture monotonic cross-runtime marks and evaluate static Proctor performance budgets locally so startup, interaction, and capability slices can retain objective evidence without a telemetry or server dependency.

items.rationale: The canonical Microsoft MIT text is preserved as the local notice for this cluster.
Preserve cross-browser, worker, and Node time-origin handling, shared global storage, explicit start times, exact clearing, and mark export behavior.
Run the complete owner mark-clearing suite through Node's built-in runner and the admitted Proctor path.
Input-latency sampling is retained for the browser-interaction slice, where its complete keyboard/input/render event lifecycle can be composed and verified in real Chromium.
VS Code telemetry reporting and aggregate workbench registration are not Proctor composition; later browser input sampling remains local unless an explicit redacted diagnostics owner is admitted.
A general startup performance editor and diagnostics command are outside the production examination workbench; Control Explorer may expose bounded development-only fixtures later.

dependencies.rationale: The admitted base runtime supplies the bounded Node-process shape used only for runtime discrimination.

dependencies.reference: Web Performance API performance.timeOrigin, mark, clearMarks, and getEntriesByType
dependencies.rationale: Electron Chromium supplies the native high-resolution source; the admitted implementation preserves its fallback behavior elsewhere.

divergences.summary: Proctor adds a namespaced static budget registry and immutable local snapshot interface; it does not inherit VS Code telemetry endpoints, product diagnostics commands, or aggregate workbench registrations.

verification.obligation: Verify exact mark-name clearing while preserving unrelated shared marks.
Verify unique positive budgets, explicit timestamps, duration evaluation, missing evidence, budget failure, and immutable snapshots.
Verify layer direction, cycles, static imports, and literal Proctor composition ownership.
Verify schema, local digest, marker, license reference, unique ownership, divergence, and evidence parity without a VS Code checkout.
Resolve the exact VS Code commit and verify every reviewed upstream blob against the canonical checkout.
